item.title: Rallying Cry – November 16, 2026
item.description: From wood storks returning to a restored Lake Texcoco and a new breast cancer pill approved by the FDA to France returning a looted Pissarro painting and private funding saving South Africa’s swimmers, today’s wins prove progress is everywhere you look.
